points.cn: 日期的表达（1）：月、日/号、星期、周
points.en: Expression of a Date (1): Month, date, day of the week
points.note:
Chinese dates observe the principle of "bigger unit comes before smaller unit".
Year - Month - Date; then day of the week.
In spoken/verbal Chinese, “号” is used instead of “日” to express the date.
Note: 周日 = 星期日 = 星期天

items.c: 你想去山东，你可以坐高铁去，特别快。
items.en: You want to go to Shandong, you can take the high-speed train, it's especially fast.

items.c: 我想去中国学汉语，因为我会说一点儿中文，也喜欢吃中国菜。
items.en: I want to go to China to study Chinese, because I can speak a little Chinese, and I also like eating Chinese food.

items.c: 这个面包多少钱？我只有十块钱，可以买吗？
items.en: How much is this bread? I only have ten yuan, can I buy it?

items.c: 我朋友是巴西人，他住在荷兰，但是他不会说荷兰语。
items.en: My friend is Brazilian, he lives in the Netherlands, but he can't speak Dutch.

items.c: 你星期日下午做什么？我想去商场买衣服，你去不去？
items.en: What are you doing on Sunday afternoon? I want to go to the mall to buy clothes, are you going?

items.c: 我的猫不在沙发上，也不在床下面，它在厨房里。
items.en: My cat is not on the sofa, and not under the bed, it is in the kitchen.

items.c: 李老师上午八点去学校，下午五点后回家。
items.en: Teacher Li goes to school at eight in the morning, and goes home after five in the afternoon.

items.c: 你会用筷子吗？我会用勺子，但是不太会用筷子。
items.en: Can you use chopsticks? I can use a spoon, but I am not very good with chopsticks.

items.c: 昨天我买了一点儿水果，苹果很甜，草莓也不错。
items.en: Yesterday I bought some fruit, the apples are very sweet, and the strawberries are good too.

items.c: 我儿子不喜欢吃鸡蛋，但是他很喜欢吃面条。
items.en: My son doesn't like eating eggs, but he really likes eating noodles.

items.c: 你什么时候能来我家？我五点后有空，我们可以一起喝茶。
items.en: When can you come to my home? I am free after five, we can drink tea together.

items.c: 这家餐馆人太多，那家咖啡馆人少，我们去那儿吧。
items.en: This restaurant has too many people, that café has few people, let's go there.

items.c: 我刚刚看见一只小狗在椅子下面，它很可爱。
items.en: I just saw a puppy under the chair, it is very cute.

items.c: 她不想学法语，她想学日语，因为她想去日本旅游。
items.en: She doesn't want to learn French, she wants to learn Japanese, because she wants to travel to Japan.

items.c: 我爸爸妈妈都在银行工作，他们很忙，周末也上班。
items.en: My mom and dad both work at a bank, they are very busy, they also work on weekends.

items.c: 你身体怎么样？我很好，就是有点儿累。
items.en: How is your health? I am fine, just a little tired.

items.c: 香港的东西太贵了，我不想去香港买东西。
items.en: Things in Hong Kong are too expensive, I don't want to go to Hong Kong to buy things.

items.c: 这个汉字怎么读？我会读，但是不会写。
items.en: How do you read this Chinese character? I can read it, but I can't write it.

items.c: 我朋友来自法国，他会说法语和英语，但是不会说汉语。
items.en: My friend comes from France, he can speak French and English, but he can't speak Mandarin.

items.c: 上午我在学校上课，下午我去超市买菜。
items.en: In the morning I have class at school, in the afternoon I go to the supermarket to buy groceries.

items.c: 你昨天吃什么了？我吃了一点儿饺子和一碗米饭。
items.en: What did you eat yesterday? I ate some dumplings and a bowl of rice.

items.c: 我妈妈喜欢在沙发上看书，我爸爸喜欢在公园散步。
items.en: My mom likes reading on the sofa, my dad likes walking in the park.

items.c: 你妈妈几岁？她在哪儿工作？
items.en: How old is your mom? Where does she work?

items.c: 我想买两个杯子，一个给妈妈，一个给朋友。
items.en: I want to buy two cups, one for mom, one for my friend.

items.c: 今天九月一号，明天星期三，我要去学校看书。
items.en: Today is September 1st, tomorrow is Wednesday, I am going to school to read.

items.c: 火车三点半到湖南，我朋友会来车站。
items.en: The train arrives in Hunan at half past three, my friend will come to the station.

items.c: 你累不累？渴不渴？要不要喝点儿水？
items.en: Are you tired? Thirsty? Do you want some water?

items.c: 我不喜欢洗碗，也不喜欢做饭，但是我会做面条。
items.en: I don't like washing dishes, and I don't like cooking, but I can make noodles.

items.c: 这个电脑怎么卖？太贵了，我没有很多钱。
items.en: How much is this computer? Too expensive, I don't have a lot of money.

items.c: 我姐姐会唱歌，也会跳舞，她周末经常去公园玩。
items.en: My older sister can sing and dance, she often goes to the park on weekends.

items.c: 你回家后喜欢做什么？我一般六点吃饭，然后看电视。
items.en: What do you like to do after you get home? I usually eat at six, then watch TV.
